title: Number of new HIV infections per 1,000 uninfected population, by sex, age and key populations
graph_title: Number of new HIV infections per 1,000 uninfected population, by sex, age and key populations
national_indicator_available: Number of new HIV infections per 1,000 uninfected population
national_indicator_description: This indicator measures the incidence of HIV as the number of new HIV infections per 1,000 uninfected population.
computation_definitions: The incidence rate is the number of new cases per population at risk in a given time period, in this case per 1,000 uninfected population.
computation_calculations: Figures are based on modelled HIV estimates. Please see the "Annex on methods" from the ["AIDS, Crisis and the Power to Transform"](https://www.unaids.org/en/resources/documents/2025/2025-global-aids-update) report for more information on HIV estimates methodology.
other_info: Further information on HIV in Rwanda is available in the [HIV Annual Reports](https://rbc.gov.rw/publications/reports) published by the Rwanda Biomedical Center (RBC).
comments_limitations: Note that, from 2022 onwards, the estimate for the 50 and above age group is <0.1; due to format constraints, it is expressed as 0.1 here. The global metadata specifies breakdowns by sex and key populations as well as age categories. Due to data availability, only age breakdowns are included here; however, breakdowns of some other relevant measures by sex and key populations are available at the linked data source.
indicator_definition: Number of new HIV infections per 1,000 persons among the uninfected population.
un_custodian_agency: The Joint United Nations Programme on HIV/AIDS (UNAIDS)
